stem: An analyst computes the quarterly win rate of Voltmarkt's business sales team as deals won / all opportunities in the pipeline, including those still open. What does this do?

options.text: It understates the win rate, since open deals count as if they were lost
It overstates the win rate, since open deals count as if they had been won
Nothing changes: open deals end up won or lost in the same share anyway
It turns the win rate into sales velocity, a value in euros a day
